prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one early website design comparison sketch for Gata Blood Bowl league.
Draw a landscape 1440x1000 first viewport of a WEBSITE. This is a flat matte deliberately unfinished UI design sketch, not a final high-fidelity comp.
Direction: everyday player app for existing league players. Warm tinted #EAE6DF ground, comfortable white rounded panels, blue #165DCC used only on actions, charcoal humanist sans typography.
Composition: clear compact mobile-inspired top navigation adapted to desktop; Gata League as the small brand at top left with a simple blank emblem placeholder, greeked navigation marks. Broad season/match task area prominent in main column with Season as its heading, task cards containing indistinct strokes for teams, fixtures, and scores. Compact team panel and quick rule lookup panel alongside, with a greeked search control. Comfortable spacing and readable hierarchy through shapes. Modest blue action buttons, white cards on warm ground, slight loose sketch imperfections.
Text (verbatim): only 'Gata League' and 'Season' may be legible. All other labels, scores, navigation and copy must be greeked indistinct strokes. Absolutely no invented dates, names, numbers, readable labels or lorem ipsum.
Avoid: device frame, photography, gloss, gradients, 3D, illustration hero, invented final logo, sports score numerals, mock data, promotional page. Keep unfinished sketch character while conveying usable player tasks.
